exposure: classic technique of classic B-Lynch suture
outcome: Success rate in controlling atonic postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 160 women with uncontrolled atonic postpartum hemorrhage after cesarean section
finding: The modified B-Lynch suture technique was found to be superior to the classic technique in controlling atonic postpartum hemorrhage, with a higher success rate and lower need for hysterectomy.
mod_finding: The study examined a modified B-Lynch suture technique for controlling postpartum hemorrhage in women who underwent cesarean delivery.
